results.description: 6-year-old, fever two days, eating and playing — pediatrics routine

transcript.patient: My daughter is six. She's had a fever for two days but she's still eating and playing like normal.
transcript.reply: I understand. Right now, are you having any trouble breathing?
That is good to hear. May I ask your sex — male or female? It helps me ask only the questions that apply to you. You may skip this if you prefer.
I understand. Any confusion, trouble breathing, or stiff neck with the fever?

transcript.patient: no, she's alert and drinking fine
transcript.reply: That is very helpful to know. Are you currently receiving chemotherapy?
I appreciate you sharing that. Do you have any rash or blisters, especially on palms, soles, or around the mouth?
Thank you for letting me know. Please measure your temperature at the booth and enter it in °C.
Thank you for doing that. Please measure your blood pressure now — you can use the machine beside you or type the numbers.
Thank you for getting those readings for me. Could you tell me when your fever first began?
I see. Are you having any other symptoms like a cough, sore throat, or stomach trouble?

transcript.patient: a bit of a runny nose, that's all
transcript.reply: Thank you for letting me know. Please enter your weight and height so we can complete your chart.

I understand you have been dealing with a fever for the past two days. Please head over to the OPD Pediatrics department. They are ready to see you there. Before you go — is there anything you'd like to ask or tell the doctor? I'll note it for them.
Alright — please proceed to OPD Pediatrics. Take care.

results.description: Migrating right-lower-quadrant pain, worse on walking — appendicitis picture, urgent

transcript.patient: My stomach's been hurting since yesterday. It started around my belly button but now it's down on the lower right, and it really hurts when I walk.
transcript.reply: I am sorry to hear you are in pain. Right now, are you having any trouble breathing?
I am glad to hear your breathing is fine. May I ask your sex — male or female? It helps me ask only the questions that apply to you. You may skip this if you prefer.
I understand. Have you vomited blood, or had bloody or black stools in the past week?
I appreciate you letting me know. On a scale of 0 to 10, how severe is the pain?
I am sorry you are in that much pain. Just to make sure I understood — do you have this right now: Abdominal pain?

I am sorry to hear you have been in so much pain since yesterday. Please head straight to the Emergency Department right now, as our team there is already expecting you and ready to help. I truly hope you feel much better very soon.
